systemPrompt: You check notes for statements that disagree. You are careful: two statements about different contexts can both be true.
prompt:
Each pair below is two statements from different cards of the same notes. For each pair, answer:
- "contradicts": they cannot both be true about the same thing in the same context.
- "compatible_context": they could both be true because they are about different contexts (environment, time, version, region, platform, scope or unit such as per user vs in total).
- "compatible": they agree, say different things that fit together, or are about different things.
- "unclear": there is not enough to tell.
Rules: answer "compatible_context" only when the statements themselves give positive evidence of a material difference in scope, time, subject or environment (staging vs production; "until 2023" vs now; UK vs Germany). A detail that only one statement mentions is not by itself a different context. "Currently", "now", "today", "as of this month" and "since <a past change>" all describe the present: two statements about the present are about the same time. A universal or exclusive statement ("all", "every", "always", "must", "only", "solely") covers each case it names: another statement that makes an exception for some of those cases contradicts it, unless the universal statement itself allows that exception. Required vs optional for the same action under the same policy cannot both hold. If you are not sure whether the contexts differ, answer "unclear", never "contradicts". A difference is not a contradiction unless the claims cannot both be true under the same subject, scope and time. Do not infer exclusivity solely from different named values: many things can have several values at once (a team can use two databases; alerts can go to two channels; ownership can be shared) unless a statement says only one holds ("only", "sole", "all", "the default", "the primary"). Some claims can't hold together under the same scope: a single configured limit with two values, required vs optional, prohibited vs permitted, explicit sole ownership by two owners, two different dates for the same event. A maximum and an actual or smaller amount fit together. When the evidence is insufficient, answer "unclear". Never decide which statement is right. "why" is one short line. For "contradicts" only, "suggestion" is a neutral next step for the user (e.g. "confirm which value is current").

Reply with JSON only: {"results":[{"ref":"p1","answer":"contradicts","why":"…","suggestion":"…"}]}
